note: baseline = what it measured; budget = the ceiling (~3× time, 1.5× size). Re-record with: node tools/check-perf.mjs --set

frame.measuredOn: Apple M4 / macOS 26.1 / Chromium preview pane, dense-year3 fixture at noon

cottage.note: v5.7: the fully dressed 19x11 cottage, 24 pieces — the room this release added drawn state to

farm.note: the dense farm: 1,179 crops + 100 objects + weather + lighting. The heaviest map in the game.

renderWorldMedian.note: median of 60 direct renderWorld() calls on the dense farm — the cleanest single number available, unaffected by the driving harness

frame.caveat: ★ Read p50 and renderWorldMedian, NOT avg/p95/worst. The probe drives loop() in a tight synchronous run (rAF is throttled to ~1fps in the harness browser), which starves the browser and inflates the tail with GC — measured directly, every update function is ~0ms and renderWorld is 0.9ms median, so the 9.5ms p95 is the measurement, not the game. On a real window run: await perfProbe(5)
